description: The components spatial 1.0 adds to https://adk-rust.com/a2ui/catalogs/forms/1.0/catalog.json, which a surface mixes with it
instructions:
App: {"component": "App", "title", "pages": [{"id", "title", "child": "<a Page's id>"}] (1 to 24), "navigation": "top|side", "initialPage"}; the home shows it as tabs.
Badge: {"component": "Badge", "text", "tone": "neutral|info|success|warning|danger"}; a status word such as "Shipped", never a decision's word.
Bar3D: {"component": "Bar3D", "title", "data": {"path": "/rows"}, "x": {"key", "label"}, "series": [{"key", "label"}] (1 to 8), "yLabel"}: a value over two categories, rows along x and series in depth; at most 50 rows.
Chart: {"component": "Chart", "kind": "bar|line|area|pie|scatter", "title", "data": {"path": "/rows"} (at most 500 row objects), "x": {"key", "type": "category|number|time", "label"}, "series": [{"key", "label"}] (1 to 8; a pie uses the first), "yLabel", "valueFormat": "number|percent|currency", "currency", "timeUnit", "window"}.
DepthCard: {"component": "DepthCard", "title", "effect": "tilt|flip|layers", "front": "<id>", "back": "<id>" (flip), "layers": [ids] (layers, at most 4)}: a card with depth; the home turns a flip card with its own button.
Globe: {"component": "Globe", "title", "points": [{"lat", "lon", "label", "group"}] (at most 500), "arcs": [{"from": [lat, lon], "to": [lat, lon], "label"}] (at most 200), "focus": {"lat", "lon"}, "spin"}: places and routes.
Graph3D: {"component": "Graph3D", "title", "nodes": [{"id", "label", "group", "x", "y", "z"}] (at most 200), "edges": [{"from", "to"}] (at most 400), "layout": "sphere|layers|given", "spin"}: a network; layers stack the groups.
KeyValue: {"component": "KeyValue", "title", "items": [{"key", "value"}] (at most 50), or "data": {"path": "/rows"} with "keyField" and "valueField"}.
Metric: {"component": "Metric", "label", "value", "unit", "format": "number|percent|currency", "currency", "delta": {"value", "goodWhen": "up|down"}, "caption", "status": "ok|warning|critical|info|neutral", "trend": {"path": "/numbers"}}.
Page: {"component": "Page", "title", "description", "layout": "stack|grid|split", "children": [ids]}.
Progress: {"component": "Progress", "label", "value": 0 to 100, "tone", "indeterminate"}. Move it with patch_surface as the work moves.
Region: {"component": "Region", "title", "layout": "stack|grid|split", "columns": 1 to 4, "tone", "variant": "plain|hero", "children": [ids]}.
Scatter3D: {"component": "Scatter3D", "title", "data": {"path"}, "x", "y", "z": {"key", "label"}, "group": "<key>", "labelKey": "<key>"}: points over three measures, coloured by group (at most 8); at most 2000 points, 24 labelled.
Scene: {"component": "Scene", "title", "objects": [{"id", "parent", "shape": "group|box|sphere|cylinder|cone|plane|torus|line|arrow|text", "position", "rotation" (degrees), "scale", "points" (line, arrow), "text" (text), "color": "chart1..chart8|ink|neutral|muted", "state": "ok|warning|critical|info", "label", "motion": {"kind": "spin|bob|pulse|orbit|path", "seconds"}, "value"}] (at most 128), "camera", "lighting", "pickInto": "/path of a ChoicePicker you show", "panels": [{"anchor": "<object id>", "child": "<id of a Text, Metric or KeyValue>"}]}.
Scene3D: {"component": "Scene3D", "title", "description", "objects": [{"id", "shape": "box|sphere|cylinder|cone|plane|torus", "position": [x, y, z], "rotation", "scale", "color": "#rrggbb", "label"}] (1 to 64), "camera", "height", "autoRotate", "controls": "none|orbit"}; primitives only, no models; the home draws it in 3D in its own colours.
Sparkline: {"component": "Sparkline", "data": {"path": "/values"} (numbers, or rows with "key"), "label", "tone", "window"}.
Stage: {"component": "Stage", "title", "description", "layout": "stage|wall|carousel", "children": [ids] (1 to 12)}: components arranged in 3D; a stage or wall holds only what shows (charts, metrics, text), a carousel may hold a form.
SurfacePlot: {"component": "SurfacePlot", "title", "values": {"path"} (rows of numbers, 2 to 64 by 2 to 64), "xLabel", "yLabel" (the value), "zLabel", "wireframe"}: a value over a grid, coloured by height.
VegaLite: {"component": "VegaLite", "title", "spec": a Vega-Lite spec with one mark (bar, line, area, point or arc) and encoding x, y, color (a series per value) or theta (a pie), "data": {"path": "/rows"} or the spec's data.values (at most 500 rows); no transforms, layers, facets or URLs.
- Put the numbers in dataModel and bind them, as {"@path": "/sales"}; never paste data into labels.
- A chart draws at most 500 rows and 8 series: aggregate or downsample first, and say so in its title.
- Label things with plain words. A drawing never shows a decision's words (Allow once, Always allow, Waiting for you, You said yes, You said no, Confirm it's you, Stop all, Resume all, Take over, Add this agent, Edit, Deny, Done, Approve, Approved, Decided, Don't add), links, images or password fields, and is refused if it does: say it in your reply or draw it another way.
- Every component needs a unique id, and one has the id root.
3D, drawn natively by the home in its own colours:
- Use 3D only when depth carries information: a value over two categories (Bar3D), three measures (Scatter3D), a value over a grid (SurfacePlot), a network (Graph3D), places and routes (Globe), a physical layout (Scene). Otherwise use Chart.
- Limits: Bar3D 50 rows by 8 series; Scatter3D 2000 points; SurfacePlot 64 by 64; Graph3D 200 nodes and 400 edges; Globe 500 places and 200 routes; Scene 128 objects, 3 lights, 4 panels, 32 moving, each motion taking 0.2 to 120 seconds (scale slow periods down and say so). Aggregate or sample first and say so in the title.
- Colours are names, never codes: chart1 to chart8, ink, neutral, muted; a state (ok, warning, critical, info) needs a label too.
- Bind data and change it with patch_surface; keep object ids so things move smoothly. Give motion only where it means something.
- To let the person pick by clicking, show a ChoicePicker, set the Scene's pickInto to its path, and give each pickable object a label and a value from its options. A Button still sends it, and the person decides.
- Panels beside objects, and a Stage's wall or stage, hold only Text, Metric, KeyValue or charts. DepthCard and Stage present components you drew; never hide what the person must read.
